answer_1.quote: Our work contributes a natural, generative QA benchmark over long-form narrative texts...

answer_2.quote: We analyze several metrics on LiteraryQA, ranging from traditional n-gram-based approaches to neural-based methods, to measure their system-level correlation with human annotations.

answer_3.quote: Regarding the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm, we use state-of-the-art LLMs accessed through APIs (GPT 4.1 and Claude 3.7 Sonnet) and Prometheus 2 7B.

answer_4.quote: We collect human judgments on the quality of generated responses... Annotators then evaluate the quality of each prediction according to the rubric.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate each prediction according to the rubric, scoring from 1 to 5 based on criteria such as correctness and relevance.
